hardware_problems.title: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU isn't read any more
hardware_problems.message: Reading NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU crashed RIGStats' sensor reader 3 times, so RIGStats stopped reading it. Fans, the CPU, lighting and the other sensors keep working — only its values are missing. A graphics card can do this when the PC switches it off to save power, or after a driver update: install the latest driver. RIGStats reads it again after Windows or the RIGStats service restarts.
hardware_problems.detail: The hardware worker ended during 'sample' (exit code 0xC0000005) after 35 s while reading NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU (/gpu-nvidia/0)
